verdict.rationale: Rive's own revision-history docs confirm that multiple people can work on the same file at the same time, with changes tracked and autosaved, so simultaneous co-editing is a documented first-party capability. Nothing in the pack describes live cursors, presence indicators, or instant real-time sync between collaborators. Missing for 10: live cursors/presence documentation, explicit real-time sync behavior, team-wide multiplayer docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, my whole team can edit the same file simultaneously with live cursors and instant sync

citations.quote: Even if multiple people are working on the same file at the same time, Rive tracks all changes and stores them in the Revision History.
Rive saves your files automatically as you work.
